% Galinstan cold-plate resistance: model, CHT simulation and measurement (Fig. 4.8).
% Data: figures/data/rcp_*.dat, generated by figures/data/make_rcp_data.py.
% Include with: \input{figures/galinstan_rcp_cfd}  (inside a figure environment)
\definecolor{galblue}{HTML}{2A78D6}
\definecolor{cfdpurple}{HTML}{5B2A86}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
    width=0.75\linewidth, height=0.45\linewidth,
    xmin=0.3, xmax=5.2, ymin=0, ymax=0.9,
    xlabel={Galinstan flow rate (\si{\milli\litre\per\second})},
    ylabel={$\Rcp$ (\si{\celsius\per\watt})},
    grid=major, major grid style={draw=black!12},
    axis lines*=left,
    tick label style={font=\footnotesize},
    label style={font=\small},
    legend style={draw=none, fill=white, fill opacity=0.85, text opacity=1,
      font=\footnotesize, at={(0.98,0.98)}, anchor=north east},
    legend cell align=left,
  ]
  \addplot[galblue, thick] table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_model_galinstan.dat};
  \addlegendentry{$\varepsilon$--NTU model}
  \addplot[cfdpurple, only marks, mark=square*, mark size=2.2pt]
    table[x=v, y=rcp] {figures/data/rcp_cfd.dat};
  \addlegendentry{CHT (SimScale, \num{427e3} cells)}
  \addplot[galblue, only marks, mark=diamond, mark size=3.5pt, thick,
    error bars/.cd, x dir=both, x explicit, y dir=both, y explicit,
    error bar style={galblue, line width=0.6pt}, error mark options={rotate=90, mark size=2pt, galblue}]
    table[x=v, y=rcp, x error=u_v, y error=u_rcp] {figures/data/rcp_meas_galinstan.dat};
  \addlegendentry{Measured}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
